steps: The saved Scene2D entry opens a new explicit assembly draft with that scene as its only member and entry. Editing and review do not save or run. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve input identity, focus, text selection, membership, complete reviewed source and save readiness. One explicit Save creates exactly one assembly JSON and one registration, keeping all pre-existing author bytes and the old assembly unchanged.

The saved assembly becomes the explicitly selected project target. Chrome plan/build/headless-run uses the actual Godot backend and existing protocol 11: three bindings on two instances produce six animation commands and two natural completions, with same-target command anchors 4 and 6. The resulting target review shows the expected shared A lane. This is a project assembly run, not standalone Scene2D support.
